title: llm-spec-audit
description: What the backend returns to `spec audit`: findings along the eight axes, limitations, the axes it could not assess and the analysis findings it reviewed. It carries no status, score or verdict: the harness computes the axis status from the severities and decides the gate.

items.description: One audit finding. The outer shape is the one of the Autonomous Improvement Harness v2 audit.schema.json; only `category` differs (the eight axes).

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Ids from the audit input (FD-0001, DEC-0001, DCI-0001, REQ-0001, RQI-0001, TL-0001, PT-0001, DOC-0001, DOC-0001#S1; DCI- and RQI- are inferred entities), each optionally followed by ': ' and a quote copied from that item. The harness checks that the id exists and the quote is in its text.

next_experiment.description: What to read or change next to confirm or resolve the finding.

limitations.description: What the audit could not look at. Severe concerns belong in findings; `spec audit` refuses limitations that use a severity word, name an input id no finding cites, name a finding, or repeat a claim.

reviewed.description: The analysis findings (FD-...) the audit checked, with the auditor's view. `verdict` is not a pass or a fail: upheld means the finding stands, disputed that the source does not support it. Every critical and high analysis finding must appear here or in the evidence of a finding.
